configure_cloud_build_flags: configure cloud build flags to use local Docker instead of remote Google Cloud Build
set_gcp_service_account: set the GCP service account name used by XManager for cloud operations
configure_kaniko_cache: configure kaniko cache TTL for Cloud Build caching
setup_db_yaml_config: setup database YAML config path with SQL connection details for XManager
check_multiplexer_usage: check whether to use a terminal multiplexer for local jobs based on flag values
